title: Add optional `@workspace` agent and decision fields, hosted kit lock pins, and uniform `ia init --system` stewardship mandates
summary: Extend `@schema workspace` with optional `composition.public-agent`, `composition.private-agent` and `composition.decides` fields; advance distribution lock engine to `0.1.3` for offline-safe `hosted` kit pins (`ia install --hosted`, `source: hosted` in `ia_session` and `IA-CORE-KIT-HOSTED` in `ia_method`); and pair `@agent <id>-steward` uniformly with `@mandate <id>-stewardship` in `ia init --system`.
